$comment: The four built-in presets (`05` §3.5.2, `01` §14 A3). `custom` is not here: it means 'read every route from `models.routes`', so a preset entry for it would be a default that silently filled a gap the host meant to fill themselves. Model ids verified against platform.claude.com/docs on 2026-11-12 — `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5` and `claude-haiku-5-5` are the current lineup.

localDefaults.$comment: Interim Local defaults by host memory (`05` §3.5.6's table; written at `M2-T12`). **Interim**: the final choice is `M8-T15`'s eval, which scores candidates on tool success, an extraction F1 subset, the discretion red-team subset and latency. These are what the wizard pre-fills until that measurement exists, so a host is never asked to type a model name they have no way to choose between. Model ids and download sizes re-verified against the Ollama library on 2026-11-13. `smallModel` is the same across every tier on purpose: the small routes (route, extract, declassify, guard) are short, frequent and latency-sensitive, so the cheapest capable model wins at every memory size — and a host who upgrades their chat model should not have their guard route change underneath them.

tiers.note: Best quality locally: tools, thinking and vision at 256K context.

Balanced: tools, thinking and vision at 256K context.
